description: Convert a Gaussian splat file (PLY, .splatz, or KHR_gaussian_splatting GLB) into an Apple ParticleField3DGaussianSplat USDZ (OpenUSD 26.03 schema pin) for RealityKit / Reality Composer Pro / Safari `<model>`. Pure-TS — no Apple toolchain. Optionally also writes the RealityKit per-channel f32 buffer set + layout.json sidecar via `realitykit_buffers_dir`. STRUCTURAL CONFORMANCE ONLY — the emitted USDZ is a valid package whose ParticleField3DGaussianSplat prim this tool re-parses; it is NOT RealityKit/visionOS render-verified (that requires Apple hardware, SPEC-0160 Phase D).

format.description: Input format (ply | splatz | glb). Auto-detected from magic bytes when omitted.

input_path.description: Sandbox-relative path to a Gaussian-splat .ply, .splatz, or KHR_gaussian_splatting .glb file.

lod_quality_gate.description: Render-free degeneracy gate: off (default) | warn | strict (strict refuses + emits nothing).

max_sh_degree.description: Clamp the SH degree down to this value (0..3) before emitting.

output_path.description: Sandbox-relative path to write the .usdz to.

realitykit_buffers_dir.description: Optional sandbox-relative dir; when set, also write the RealityKit f32 buffers + layout.json.

up_axis.description: Stage up-axis (default Y, the captured fixture).

name: splat_to_usdz
title: Splat → Apple ParticleField USDZ (SPEC-0160)
